author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Five! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independently published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Well... the Patrons finally did it. They've been pressing me to review and AI generated asset game for a while so I can say my peace about it. The Last Drifters is a Car-Combat game in a generic post apocalyptic wasteland with heavy Gaslands and Death Race influences. Can you tell already how I feel about it? Let's check it out!
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 085 - The Last Drifters  by Mac Cross and Midjourney?!
